description.value: Sabai Thai Restaurant is a Thai cuisine restaurant in Surrey, BC. The OSM record indicates the premises are wheelchair accessible and smoke-free. No further detail about the restaurant's character or offerings can be confirmed, as the website URL in OSM leads to an unrelated restaurant of the same name in Ottawa, Ontario.

None of this content corresponds to the Surrey, BC location in the OSM record, so no website evidence can be applied to any amenity field. OSM tags (wheelchair=yes, smoking=no, cuisine=thai) are the only available evidence for the Surrey listing; all amenity fields must remain null pending correct website identification.
